g.text: openmeet-engine: persistence queue and forgetting deleted meetings
flush() queues a Barrier and waits up to 10 s
persist(): drops a write whose meeting_id() is in
forget_meeting(): refuses while the meeting is live,
records the id in deleted (at most MAX_DELETED = 256),
cancels and removes its summary token, awaits
MeetingStateChanged with meeting_id None, state Idle)
if it was the current meeting.
